en: Black‑and‑white view of a substantial villa or guesthouse with a tiled roof and large glassed‑in veranda, set in a wooded valley. Terraced gardens and cultivated beds occupy the foreground. A tall chimney stands behind an adjoining lower wing. On the hillside road to the right there is a signboard reading "Grundmühle". Some partially visible wall text on the building suggests it may be an inn or restaurant.
